content:
Scheme: General (all HDFC Mutual Fund schemes) | Plan: Direct and Regular | Document: HDFC Mutual Fund: Consolidated Account Statement request | Section: 1. What is an Account Statement (AS)?
An Account Statement (AS) is a consolidated document that provides a detailed summary of all mutual fund transactions carried out by an investor. It includes information such as purchases, redemptions, switches, dividends, and the units allotted in the folio.

section: 2. When can I download the Account Statement?
content:
Scheme: General (all HDFC Mutual Fund schemes) | Plan: Direct and Regular | Document: HDFC Mutual Fund: Consolidated Account Statement request | Section: 2. When can I download the Account Statement?
You can download the AS as soon as you begin investing with us.An Account Statement is generated each time a transaction is processed and units are allotted in the investor’s folio.

section: 3. Is there a charge or fee for receiving the Account Statement?
content:
Scheme: General (all HDFC Mutual Fund schemes) | Plan: Direct and Regular | Document: HDFC Mutual Fund: Consolidated Account Statement request | Section: 3. Is there a charge or fee for receiving the Account Statement?
No. There is no charge or fee for receiving or downloading your Account Statement.

section: 4. What types of statements can be downloaded through the AS feature?
content:
Scheme: General (all HDFC Mutual Fund schemes) | Plan: Direct and Regular | Document: HDFC Mutual Fund: Consolidated Account Statement request | Section: 4. What types of statements can be downloaded through the AS feature?
You can download the following types of statements:
PAN-based Account Statement: Consolidated view of all folios linked to the PAN.Folio-based Account Statement: Statement specific to a single folio.
